# Elm City Photography

> Engagement, proposal, and graduation portrait photography based in New Haven, Connecticut. Travel anywhere in Connecticut is included.

Contact: hello@elmcityphotography.com · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/elm.city.photography
Replies within 48 hours.

## Services and pricing

- [Engagement sessions](https://elmcityphotography.com/engagement-pricing/): The Afternoon $375 (1 hour, 40+ images), The Chapter $695 (2 hours, 60+ images, 5×7 print), The Experience $995 (3 hours, 100+ images, 11×14 print).
- [Graduation sessions](https://elmcityphotography.com/graduation-pricing/): The Mini $175 (30 minutes, 15+ images), The Portrait $275 (1 hour, 30+ images), The Celebration $395 (90 minutes, 50+ images). Add another graduate for $125.
- Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and greater New York are available for a small flat travel fee.
